description: Choose any of 22 Helldivers 2 weapon and equipment mods in Arsenal, or enable the full set. One True Flag has one dropdown with 29 damage presets, defaulting to 300 normal / 150 durable. Includes Sickle, Tenderizer and Pacifier; Punisher Plasma is a separate project.

option_descriptions.Enable AC-8 Autocannon Backpackless Rewo: The call-in supplies only the weapon, freeing the backpack slot. The gun carries 10 loaded + 60 reserve rounds and uses its familiar five-round top reload while walking, about 20% faster than stock. A resupply is set to refill up to 60 reserve rounds. Ergonomics rises from 17 to 30. Horizontal/vertical recoil drift falls from 200/450 to 150/337.5 and recoil climb from 2/100 to 1.5/75, a 25% reduction to each. APHET direct damage becomes 375 normal / 340 durable with AP5, and impact blast becomes 180 normal. FLAK explosion damage becomes 210 normal with an 8 m outer radius; FLAK direct damage and shrapnel are unchanged. JAR-5 Dominator High Explosive ammo shares that explosion and receives the same explosion buff.
option_descriptions.Enable AR-11 Arbitrator: Sets rifle damage to 80 and magazine capacity to 65 rounds. Sets underbarrel starting and maximum spare ammo to 30, stagger force to 25, and push force to 20. Its shotgun magazine holds 4 shells and refills 20 shells. Base ergonomics is 41, giving 40 with the default optic.
option_descriptions.Enable AR-32 Pacifier Tuning: Bullets deal 75 normal and 15 durable damage, up from 55/10, and build Stun Medium at strength 3 per hit, up from 2. Its default magazine holds 65 rounds, up from 40, and weapon sway falls from 1 to 0.6.
option_descriptions.Enable ARC-12 Blitzer: Sets normal damage to 100, durable damage to 45, arc range to 30 m, and fire rate to 80 RPM.
option_descriptions.Enable ARC-3 Rapid/Supercharge: Adds the native Auto/Rapid and Semi/Supercharge fire-mode selector. Rapid charges in 0.307692/0.338462/0.369231 seconds and uses 0.85x of the shared 226/90 normal/durable pulse damage (about 192.1/76.5 before armor and hit location). Supercharge charges in 3.4/3.5/3.75 seconds, uses 2325/2325 damage and AP7, targets one enemy (chain 1, split 0), and cannot explode from overcharge. Both modes keep stock ARC audio and 45 m reach.
option_descriptions.Enable CQC-20 Breaching Hammer: Sets direct-hit, slight-blast, and large-blast armor penetration to 7. Sets starting, resupply, and maximum magazine counts to 21 each.
option_descriptions.Enable Gas Overhaul: Adds 15-second temporary armor reduction to supported gas weapons, including Dog Breath and gas grenades. Shared gas normal/durable damage rises from 25/25 to 45/45 DPS; Sterilizer magazine capacity from 125 to 175, gas/confusion buildup from 0.5 to 0.75, and incoming Helldiver gas multiplier from 1.3 to 0.7333. Shared Acid Storm duration changes from 1 to 15 seconds.
option_descriptions.Enable One True Flag: Choose damage from one dropdown with 29 presets. Normal-damage choices are 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 750, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 3,000, 5,000, 7,500 and 9,999. Durable damage can be half of normal, rounded down, or equal to normal; zero has one 0/0 choice. Default: 300 normal / 150 durable.
option_descriptions.Enable P-34 Breacher: Sets the magazines received from resupply to 2.
option_descriptions.Enable PLAS-1 Scorcher AR: Increases the magazine from 20 to 50 rounds and fire rate from 350 to 540 RPM. Reduces normal damage from 200 total to 150: 75 impact plus 75 explosion, before armor, hit location and distance falloff. Sets impact durable damage to 38 and explosion durable damage to 75 (113 combined against fully durable targets). Increases the full-damage blast radius from 1 to 1.25 metres and outer blast radius from 2 to 2.5 metres. Starting spare magazines increase from 3 to 4, and maximum spare magazines from 5 to 6; resupply grants 5 magazines. Uses the Scorcher's native Semi and Auto selector. Select Auto in Weapon Functions for continuous fire; at 540 RPM, a 50-round magazine provides approximately 5.56 seconds of sustained fire. Reduces horizontal/vertical recoil drift from 20 to 15, horizontal camera recoil from 2 to 1.5, and vertical camera recoil from 20 to 15 (25% less per shot).
option_descriptions.Enable PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle: Sets magazine capacity to 21, horizontal/vertical drift and camera recoil to 2, horizontal/vertical spread to 0.3, sway to 0.4, stagger to 25, direct-hit and blast armor penetration to 4, and outer blast/shockwave values to 2.5. Offers near-instant Semi fire at a base rate of 200 RPM and charged three-round Burst with normal firing audio.
option_descriptions.Enable PLAS-45 Epoch Highest-Charge Rewo: PLAS-45 Epoch highest-charge shots gain 30% more normal and durable direct-hit and blast damage, burning on blast hits, a 5 m full-damage radius, 6 m outer damage radius and 7 m shockwave radius. Magazine capacity increases from 3 to 4 rounds and maximum spare magazines from 4 to 5. Reload while walking with the existing reload animation. Base highest-tier direct damage is 520/260 and blast damage is 1040/1040, with its existing charge multiplier retained. Charge times remain 1.0/2.5/2.6 seconds and lower-charge shots retain their current values. Starting/resupply spare magazines remain 2/2.
option_descriptions.Enable R/40-K Hot-Shot: Sets magazine capacity to 20 rounds, starting magazines to 5, resupply magazines to 5, maximum magazines to 5, and ergonomics to 45. Uses standard magazine reloads.
option_descriptions.Enable S-11 Speargun: Sets starting magazines to 16, resupply magazines to 10, maximum magazines to 20, and ergonomics to 40.
option_descriptions.Enable SAI Focus Precision: LAS-12 SAI deals 90 normal and 21 durable damage at the muzzle with either lens. Standard Lens spread is 70 MRAD and Focus Lens spread is 37.5 MRAD on both axes, each 50% below stock. Both lenses fire at 900 RPM. Projectile launch speed is 1,300 m/s and drag is 1.244, adding damage loss over distance. Recoil is reduced by one-third with both lenses. Heat per shot is reduced by one-third: 2 to 1.333333 with Standard and cooldown heatsinks, or 1.5 to 1 with the heat-capacity heatsink.
option_descriptions.Enable Sickle Laser AR: LAS-16 Sickle deals 70 normal and 10 durable damage and generates 50% less heat per shot, from 1.15 to 0.575. LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle deals 65/10 normal/durable damage cold and warm, then 83/14 at hot and maximum heat. Both weapons have at least AP3 penetration; Double-Edge reaches AP4 at maximum heat. Both Sickles have a base fire rate of 700 RPM, zero horizontal and vertical spread, and 2,000 m/s projectiles at every heat tier with no distance damage fall-off. Double-Edge direct heat self-damage is reduced by 25%. Its heat buildup, cooling and maximum-heat ignition remain unchanged; general fire damage is unchanged.
option_descriptions.Enable Tenderizer Armor Softener: AR-61 Tenderizer magazine capacity increases from 35 to 70 rounds and bullet launch speed from 820 to 1,000 m/s. Direct and slight-angle armor penetration increase from AP2 to AP3; the other angle settings remain unchanged. Bullets apply Acid Storm to temporarily reduce enemy armor effectiveness for 15 seconds. Base sway is set to 0.9. Normal/durable damage is 90/30, with the existing 600/850 RPM settings, recoil and spread. The shared Acid Storm duration also affects its weather effect after exposure ends.
option_descriptions.Enable VG-70 Variable Portable Maxigun R: Keeps its primary slot, mobile reload and backpack-free operation. Magazine capacity becomes 150 rounds. Auto offers 550, 750 and 1,000 RPM at 110/29, 90/24 and 75/20 normal/durable damage per bullet, AP3. Volley fires 15 simultaneous bullets at 40/11 each, AP3, following the selected 550, 750 or 1,000 RPM rate. Total fires all remaining rounds at 28/8 per bullet, AP4, with 0.75 spread on both axes. Spare-magazine settings remain 6 starting, 7 maximum and 7 per resupply. Base ergonomics becomes 40 and sway becomes 0.9. Recoil falls 15% in every mode: horizontal/vertical drift 5/10 becomes 4.25/8.5, and climb 4/8 becomes 3.4/6.8. Total retains its stock right-arm self-injury and knockdown behavior. Sustained Auto muzzle flashes stay aligned. Reload timing, projectile speed and sounds are retained.
